title: AURELIA
tagline: La lumière, à fleur de peau.
blurb: An ethereal maison de parfum whose hero is a physically-modeled thin-film iridescent silk, written in raw GLSL.

title: GROTESK™
tagline: Type is infrastructure. Decoration is debt.
blurb: A brutalist type-foundry specimen site where dragging the headline live-warps a variable font's weight and width axes.

title: STRATA
tagline: Every visit, the gallery paints again
blurb: A generative gallery that mints a unique seeded flow-field painting on every visit, with a re-mint button that commissions a fresh one.

title: DEEPFIELD STATION
tagline: All systems nominal. Until they aren't.
blurb: A live 1978 mission console for a deep-space telescope — telemetry ticks, a survey map slews, and the sky occasionally misbehaves.

title: 間 MA
tagline: The pause between ink and paper
blurb: A fictional Kyoto paper-and-ink studio built as a meditation on negative space — a self-drawing sumi-e brushstroke, morphing stone, seasonal haiku, and a hanko seal that stamps the footer.

title: CHROMATIC.SYS
blurb: A Y2K liquid-chrome driver that renders your subconscious at 240 Hz, no restart required.

title: MERIDIAN
tagline: Nothing on this page is an accident.
blurb: A Swiss International-Style magazine where a twelve-column grid, red hairlines, and Müller-Brockmann's arcs argue for precision.

title: Descent
blurb: A scroll-driven descent from sunlit surface to the Challenger Deep, with five bioluminescent encounters and a live depth-meter HUD.

title: CORPUS
tagline: One body, four formations, always remembers its shape.
blurb: A 45,000-particle WebGL universe that morphs between a torus knot, a spiral galaxy, a lattice, and its own name — hold to scatter, release to recall.

title: OSCILLATE
tagline: Two detuned oscillators. One filter arbitrates.
blurb: A playable 1984-style polysynth: two detuned oscillators, resonant filter, analog-type delay and a lookahead arpeggiator, all hand-synthesized with Web Audio.
